label: Algolia
description: Hosted search: browse and manage records in Algolia indices.
notes: browse-records simplified to a single first-page GET browse (the piece loops over cursors up to a limit; cursor is lifted so callers can paginate manually). delete-records simplified from a batch-delete-plus-task-poll to Algolia's official single-object DELETE endpoint. save-records not transpiled: it maps a user JSON array into a typed batch requests body and polls task status, which the HTTP template runtime cannot express. The piece's generic custom-api-call action also skipped (arbitrary body). AP dynamic index dropdown became a plain text field.

nodes.label: Algolia: Browse Records
nodes.description: Fetch the first page of records from an Algolia index, with a cursor for continuing.
nodes.search: algolia browse records index objects list export search hits dump

config.label: Index Name
config.help: Name of the Algolia index to browse

credentials.help: Application ID from the Algolia dashboard under Settings > API Keys
Algolia API key with the browse ACL (search-only keys will not work)

nodes.label: Algolia: Delete Record
nodes.description: Remove a single record from an Algolia index by its objectID.
nodes.search: algolia delete record object remove index objectid cleanup

config.label: Index Name
config.help: Name of the Algolia index containing the record

config.label: Object ID
config.help: The objectID of the record to delete

credentials.help: Application ID from the Algolia dashboard under Settings > API Keys
Algolia API key with the deleteObject ACL (search-only keys will not work)
